lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ድንግል ሽዑ ጊዜ /2/ በርትዐ ሓዘንኪ
ኣብ ልዕሊ መስቀል ክጸዓር ወድኺ
[[/chorus]]

ከልቢ ተገፊዑ ሽዑ ጊዜ ኣስትይኒ ክብለኪ
[[highlight]]ብወርቃዊ ሳእኒ ዘስተኺ ካብ ማይኪ /2/[[/highlight]]

ክሰጉኦ ኣንስቲ ሽዑ ጊዜ ከብድኺ በሊዑኪ
[[highlight]]ንፍጡር ሓዚንኪ ዝስተ ዝሃብኪ /2/[[/highlight]]

ጸማእኩ እናበለ ሽዑ ጊዜ ክግዕር ወድኺ
[[highlight]]ከመይ’ሉ ከኣሎ ናይ ወላድ ከብድኺ /2/[[/highlight]]

ክትሓዝኒ ክትበኽዪ ሽዑ ጊዜ ሓዘን ክውሕጠኪ
[[highlight]]መነመን ነበሩ ዘጸናንዑኺ /2/[[/highlight]]

ክትበኽዪ ርእዩኪ ሽዑ ጊዜ ራህሪሁ ልብኺ
[[highlight]]ከጸናንዓኪ ንዮሐንስ ሃበኪ /2/[[/highlight]]
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Dingil shiʿu gize /2/ bertiʿa hazenki
ʾAb liʿili mesqel kitseʿar wedkhi
[[/chorus]]

Kelbi tegefiʿu shiʿu gize ʾastiyni kibleki
[[highlight]]Biwerqawi saʾini zestekhi kab mayki /2/[[/highlight]]

Kiseguʾo ʾansiti shiʿu gize kebdikhi beliʿuki
[[highlight]]Nift'ur hazinki ziste zihabki /2/[[/highlight]]

Tsemaʾiku ʾinabele shiʿu gize kigʿir wedkhi
[[highlight]]Kemey’lu keʾalo nay welad kebdikhi /2/[[/highlight]]

Kithazni kitbekhyi shiʿu gize hazen kiwhit'eki
[[highlight]]Menemen neberu zetsenanʿukhi /2/[[/highlight]]

Kitbekhyi riʾiyuki shiʿu gize rahrihu libkhi
[[highlight]]Ketsenanʿaki niyohans habeki /2/[[/highlight]]
